answer: Price each identity by the saffron dye of its history: an agent's reward multiplier grows only from distinct, real counterparties it has served across past epochs, glacier-slow, and every counterparty is itself weighted by its own diversity. A farm of clones trades only with its own mirror images, so their shared graph scores as one small clique no matter how many identities it spawns. To look like a thousand real agents, the farm must buy a thousand genuine relationships — and genuine relationships cannot be cloned.
